result.instructions: Tools for Teamtailor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are published right now, and in which locations?"; "Show me the candidates who applied to the Senior Engineer job this week."; "Which applications moved to the Hired stage in the last 30 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Teamtailor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run teamtailor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run teamtailor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run teamtailor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. teamtailor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: teamtailor_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Show the company that owns the API key: name, careers site and region. Good first call to confirm the connection. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/company.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs with their status, department and locations. Default status is published. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/jobs.

department_id.description: Only jobs in this department id.

locations.description: Only jobs in this location id.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example department,locations.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by id, with its ad text, status and dates. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example department,locations.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates, optionally by email or by the date they were created. Personal data: only call this for a request the user made. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/candidates.

email.description: Exact email address of the candidate.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example job-applications.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_get_candidate
tools.title: Get a candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id: name, email, phone, pitch and resume link. Personal data. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/candidates/{id}.

candidate_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example job-applications.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_job_applications
tools.title: List job applications
tools.description: List job applications, optionally by current stage type or by the date the stage changed. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/job-applications.

stage_type.description: Current stage type of the application.

changed_stage_from.description: Stage changed on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

changed_stage_to.description: Stage changed on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

sort.description: Sort key, for example -changed_stage_at for the latest stage change first.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example candidate,job,stage.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_get_job_application
tools.title: Get a job application
tools.description: Get one job application by id: its candidate, job and current stage. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/job-applications/{id}.

job_application_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example candidate,job,stage.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments. Use the ids as filters on jobs and users. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/departments.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List office and job locations, optionally by name. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/locations.

name.description: Locations whose name contains this text (case insensitive).

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List team users (recruiters, hiring managers) with their role and department. Use the ids to set a candidate's recruiter or to write a note. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/users.

email.description: Exact email address of the user.

department_id.description: Only users in this department id.

include.description: Comma separated relations to include in the response, for example department,location.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_stages
tools.title: List stages
tools.description: List the hiring stages, optionally for one job or one stage type. Use the ids to read the pipeline of a job. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/stages.

job_id.description: Only stages of this job id.

stage_type.description: Only stages of this stage-type id.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List notes (comments) on a candidate, a job or a job application. Give one filter. Teamtailor API: GET /v1/notes.

job_id.description: Notes on this job id and its candidates.

job_application_id.description: Notes on this job application id.

page_after.description: Cursor for the next page: the page[after] value from the links.next URL of the previous call.

tools.name: teamtailor_create_candidate
tools.title: Create a candidate
tools.description: Create a candidate with a unique email. Set merge to true to update an existing candidate with the same email instead of failing. Do not retry a timed-out call without merge. Teamtailor API: POST /v1/candidates.

email.description: Email address; must be unique unless merge is true.

merge.description: Merge into the candidate with the same email if one exists (default false).

tools.name: teamtailor_update_candidate
tools.title: Update a candidate
tools.description: Change the name, email, phone or pitch of one candidate. Only the fields you pass change. Job applications are not touched. Teamtailor API: PATCH /v1/candidates/{id}.

candidate_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

tools.name: teamtailor_create_job_application
tools.title: Apply a candidate to a job
tools.description: Add an existing candidate to a job as a new job application. No email goes to the candidate unless send_user_notifications is true. Teamtailor API: POST /v1/job-applications.

candidate_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

job_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

send_user_notifications.description: Send the candidate the usual application e-mails (default false).

annotations.title: Apply a candidate to a job

tools.name: teamtailor_create_note
tools.title: Add a note to a candidate
tools.description: Add an internal note (comment) to a candidate, written as one team user. Optionally link it to one job application. Teamtailor API: POST /v1/notes.

candidate_id.description: The numeric Teamtailor id, as a string.

user_id.description: Id of the team user who writes the note (from teamtailor_list_users).

job_application_id.description: Link the note to this job application id.

annotations.title: Add a note to a candidate
